verdict.rationale: React's docs clearly cover the modular half of the story: apps are built from encapsulated components that manage their own state and compose into screens, pages, and apps. Components receive data through typed props. Nothing in the evidence documents a dependency-injection mechanism, though; props-based data passing is at most an implicit form of it. Missing for 10: a documented dependency-injection or provider mechanism (e.g., context/providers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of DI-style architecture.
